properties.description:
Eleven tests.

pointer.rs, seven: a pointer names its design and the designs beside it; it sits beside the folder's .reflow2/; no file is no pointer; an unusable pointer is refused by name (missing id or address, a non-id, a non-address, a key, not a table, a bad [[also]]), naming the file; the notice names the design and says the local store was left alone and lists [[also]]; a different design or a refusal attaches nothing and says why, an unconfirmed server does not; the graph id is read from structured content or text, never from an error.

proxy.rs, one: the notice goes in front of the server's handshake instructions and nowhere else.

End to end over the real binary, three, with the machine-wide entry's flags (--graph-path .reflow2/graph --shared --only-if-present) and an isolated REFLOW2_CONFIG_DIR against a registry server holding the named design: a folder with a pointer AND a leftover local store is attached to the named design (design_identity returns its id), the handshake says so and that the local store was not opened, and no shared server is spawned for it; a pointer naming a design the server does not hold attaches nothing and says which design it holds; an unusable pointer is refused by name and the local store is not opened.
properties.findings:
All eleven pass. The whole reflow2-mcp suite passes with them: 109 test binaries, 707 tests, 0 failures. So do the gates that drive the real binary through start-up: test_shared_sessions, test_export_to_reaches_the_daemon, test_shared_attach_from_another_folder, test_degraded_server, test_stale_seat, test_latent_promotion, test_nudge_path, stateless_seat_probe, smoke_mcp, toolsnap. Clippy -D warnings and fmt are clean.

OBSERVED FAILING FIRST, on the released 0.72.0 binary: the same folder (a local store plus a .reflow2.toml naming another design), started with the same flags, attached to the local store (design_identity returned its id, cc047a498dc416df) and spawned a shared server for it.
properties.name: A client started in a folder with a .reflow2.toml attaches to the named design over a leftover store, refuses a wrong design or a bad file, and says so
